caseName: Security Land and Exploration Company v. Weckey
caseNameFull: Security Land & Exploration Company, Plff. in Err. v. Henry Weckey
summary:
ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OP THE STATE OP MINNESOTA.

Argued simultaneously with, by the same counsel, and on the same briefs as, No. 127.

opinions.author: Pecicham
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Pecicham

delivered the opinion of the court.

*189 In this case land in the same section as in the foregoing case is involved, and as the title depends upon precisely the same facts, this case is by stipulation of counsel to abide the event of the other.

Judgment affirmed.
